# True Lean namespace of every library module (generated by facts/make_appA.py)

`\Lthm{Module}{name}` prints `QuantumFluids.Module.name`.  That is the TRUE fully qualified name for 24 of 37 modules;
for the 13 below the namespace declared in the source is different, so the printed name would be wrong.

| module | namespace in the source | example fully qualified name |
|---|---|---|
| DissipativeVortexDynamics | `DissipativeVortexDynamics` | `DissipativeVortexDynamics.energy_dissipation` |
| Duality | `Mathesis.Duality` | `Mathesis.Duality.sqrt_le_max_of_le_mul` |
| EinsteinRelation | `EinsteinRelation` | `EinsteinRelation.hasDerivAt_p_x` |
| FrictionKinetic | `FrictionKinetic` | `FrictionKinetic.coeff_eq_weighted_mean` |
| KTFlow | `KTFlow` | `KTFlow.f_antitone` |
| MadelungSplit | `QuantumFluids.Madelung` | `QuantumFluids.Madelung.normSq_phase_mul` |
| MatchingScreening | `MatchingScreening` | `MatchingScreening.norm_exp_sub_exp_le` |
| PairPolarisation | `PairPolarisation` | `PairPolarisation.norm_wave` |
| QuantizedCirculation | `QuantumFluids.Circulation` | `QuantumFluids.Circulation.circulation_quantized` |
| QuantumFluidsShell | `QuantumFluids.ShellComplex` | `QuantumFluids.ShellComplex.re_conj_sq_mul` |
| QuasiPeriodicBound | `QuasiPeriodicBound` | `QuasiPeriodicBound.trig_sum_bound` |
